statement: It prints in one piece with supports off, the windway is clear end to end, and it speaks on the first gentle breath
rationale: Nothing here slices or prints. The evaluators judge the geometry of the file; strings, sag in the two bridges, a windway that closed up, a wall that leaks and whether the edge tone starts are found only on a printed part.

mechanism.how: Print it belly-down with supports off, as PRINT.md in the exported package says. It passes when all three hold: the print finishes as one piece and nothing rattles inside or hangs in the window or the finger hole; a 1 mm drill shank or feeler passes through the windway from the tail to the window; with the finger hole sealed, a gentle breath gives a steady note at once, not hiss alone. Any one failing fails it. A photo of the print and a sound clip are the evidence.
